title: Permissions, fixes & legal updates
highlights: Settings → Device & timers → Permissions & connections: shortcuts for app permissions and notification settings, plus Allowed/Denied status for location and notifications. Opening system location settings no longer errors or locks the app.
Workout quick log: Walk and Jog open the log form directly; More opens the full picker in one modal, with Change activity to switch without closing.
GPS route maps start with map attribution collapsed (ⓘ only) so the route isn't covered on small screens.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service updated for Health Connect, GPS routes, maps, notifications, and diagnostic logs.

title: GPS route maps
highlights: Cardio sessions with GPS now show an interactive map with streets and parks—not just a line on a plain background. Open a session in Health → History, during a workout after recording or import, in the quick activity log, or on a completed workout summary.
Map colors follow Settings → Appearance (Auto, Light, or Dark) so the basemap matches the rest of the app.
Your route still shows as an accent-colored line with green start and red end markers; you can pan and zoom the map.

title: Workout tabs, filters & timer alerts
highlights: Workout and Health use header tabs—Today, Week, and History under Workout; Health and Exercises under Health. Week and History hide while you're in a live workout or customizing today's plan.
Adding an exercise to a round shows the same category filter chips as the Library. Filters reset when you close the picker; Random Pick is gone.
On Android, rest and set timers can alert you with a notification when the app is in the background—sound and vibration follow Settings → Device & timers.
Guided and Custom week builders are no longer on the main Settings screen; open them from Settings → Training.
